newReleases.name: Catch & Shoot: Fishing Game
newReleases.desc:
Catch the fish. Watch it jump. Take the shot.

Catch & Shoot: Fishing Game brings fishing and midair target shooting together in short 3D sessions. Cast your line, hold to reel in a fish and manage the line tension. When it leaps from the water, aim and shoot before it gets away.

Discover 10 different fish and fill your Fish Collection. Each new catch reveals a collection card, while repeat catches add to your total and bring you closer to unlocking another weapon.

Ready for a faster challenge? In Timed Shoot, fish jump from the water one after another. Choose a 30 or 60-second round, land as many shots as you can and see your catch count and accuracy at the end.

Features:

• Cast, reel and shoot in the main Fishing mode
• Manage line tension while reeling
• Aim at fish during their midair jump
• Play 30 or 60-second Timed Shoot rounds
• Discover 10 fish and track your collection
• Unlock four weapons as your catch total grows
• Enjoy colorful 3D graphics and simple controls

Time your shot, discover every fish and keep building your collection.

newReleases.seller: Guangzhou Neon Information Technology Co., Ltd
newReleases.desc:
黃巾亂起，朝野動盪，大漢江山分崩離析。天下豪雄趁勢而起，諸侯割據四方，戰火蔓延城郭鄉野。梟雄懷吞併天下之志，義士抱匡扶社稷之心，無數武將謀臣登場，譜寫一段段可歌可泣的亂世傳奇。在這風雲變幻的時代，你將作為一方勢力的掌權者，招攬四海豪傑，籌劃軍策，征戰四方，書寫屬於你的三國霸業。

離線掛機躺收資源，告別爆肝刷本；抽中新武將即可直接上陣，無需耗費資源重複培養。打破品質束縛，所有武將皆可突破至無雙境界，無論蓋世名將，或是冷門文臣武吏，只要是你心儀的角色，都能成為隊伍核心主 C。

【幻想亂世・群賢匯聚】
百餘位三國武將經過全新美術演繹，魏、蜀、吳、羣四方豪傑盡數登場。於酒館邂逅各路名將，解鎖武將專屬傳記，窺見英雄背後不為人知的故事，沉浸式感受波瀾壯闊的漢末風雲。

【離線放置，輕鬆征伐天下】
主線闖關全自動戰鬥，離線掛機持續產出金幣、裝備、各類養成素材。上線一鍵領取全部累積收益，利用碎片化時間就能實力進階。閒暇之餘掛機養成，空閒時間調整隊伍陣容，無需耗費大量時間反覆刷關。

【策略佈陣，自由搭配陣容】
不局限傳統強力國家隊，高自由度陣容隨意組合。武將羈絆連攜、神兵秘寶、戰魂加持、站位博弈，不存在一套通吃全關卡的萬能隊伍。依據敵方陣容靈活調整武將，無損切換隊員，巧謀克敵，以智謀決勝沙場。

【多元玩法，飽覽三國風華】
闖關試煉、秘境探險、跨服演武、群雄擂台、軍團混戰等豐富內容。PVE 闖關尋覓絕世寶物，PVP 與全服玩家同台角逐；加入軍團與盟友同心協力攻伐城池，豐厚獎勵全軍團成員皆可共享。

【良心養成，拒絕無謂內卷】
武將裝備、等級、星階一鍵轉移，培養錯武將也不用從頭再來。低品質武將同樣可以培養至畢業強度，零氪、微氪玩家也能搭建心儀的強力隊伍。隨心組建你的幻想三國軍團，縱橫中原，成就亂世霸業。

newReleases.name: 360 Sniper Showdown
newReleases.desc:
360 Sniper Showdown is a fast, timing-based duel played against real people. Your scout runs automatically along a lane, your rival runs along another, each at randomized speeds, and the only decision that matters is when to pull the trigger. Pick your moment and fire.

ONLINE 1V1 DUELS
Get matched with a random real opponent. Matches are first to two rounds. Each round gives both players a fresh random pace, from 0.90x to 1.60x, and a fresh set of three bullets. Online matches use real players only, with no bots.

ONLINE 2V2 TEAMS
Team up with one random teammate against two real rivals in larger arenas with longer lanes and more separated cover. There is no friendly fire. Knock out the rival team to win the round, and everyone returns for the next one.

THE 360 SPIN
Tap 360 and your rifle rotates through every angle. Fire during the spin to take shots you could not otherwise line up. A spinning hit counts as one round under the normal rules.

DESTRUCTIBLE COVER
Every outlined shape in the arena is solid. A bullet that hits cover is spent, and the obstacle disappears for everyone. Clear a path but make sure to save your ammo.

HAND-DRAWN ARENAS
Play across a rotating collection of arenas, each with its own art, theme and layout of cover. Browse them in the in-game arena atlas, with separate catalogs for 1v1 and 2v2. Some arenas have a night-sky look, and the game supports light and dark appearance.

PRACTICE ANYTIME
A guided tutorial teaches movement, pace, firing and the 36

newReleases.name: Galaxy Grove: Space Farm
newReleases.desc:
NO FORCED ADS. EVER!
Nothing pops up telling you to buy. Ads only play if you tap to watch one for a bonus, and the No-Ads Pass skips them for good. The shop sells skins and time-savers, never surprise pop-ups.

Your little ship has crash-landed on Sprout, a tiny planet covered in glowing alien plants. Gather, craft, level up and fix your shuttle, then fly on to new worlds.

14 SKILLS THAT FEED EACH OTHER
Harvesting, Mining, Logging, Salvage, Fishing, Hydroponics, Fabrication, Cooking and six combat skills. Every station levels up too, with new recipes and perks, and what one skill makes, another one needs.

A CUTE ALIEN CREW
Hire bouncy Blips and goggled Gizmos for each world. Blips gather, Gizmos run your stations, and Haulers carry loads home. Your crew keeps working while you're away, so there's always something waiting when you come back.

FIVE WORLDS TO EXPLORE
Sprout's glowing valley, the crystal domes of Lumen, Clank's copper quarries, and the two lost moons of the Lost Relay: clockwork Tocktock and Ahoy, a floating pirate galleon.

REAL COMBAT
Pick a Blaster, Glaive or Star Disc and take on rock golems and giant Crown golems. Climb the Tower of Power floor by floor, earn combat drones that fight beside you, and race your friends on the Game Center leaderboard.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Drag anywhere to walk, tap to work
• Plays offline, no account needed
• Short sessions or long ones: your farm keeps growing either way

More worlds are on the way.

newReleases.name: Sloppy Tanks
newReleases.desc:
Little tanks. Big mess.

Sloppy Tanks is a fast top-down tank battler. Pick your tank, pick a map and roll out against squads of bots that flank, take cover and fight back.

THREE TANKS
• Skipper: a light scout that darts between cover
• Bruiser: the balanced all-rounder
• Big Rig: a heavy tank that soaks up punishment

TWO WAYS TO FIGHT
• Team Battle: 6 versus 6 with respawns, first team to 100 wins
• Solo Assault: you against endless waves of enemies

A BATTLEFIELD THAT FALLS APART
Houses crumble, trees splinter, fuel drums explode and take their neighbours with them. Blast open new lanes or hide behind what's left.

TRICKS IN THE TRACKS
Lay mines behind you, grab supply crates for repairs, and switch between special rounds to fit the fight.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Touch controls on iPhone and iPad: drive with the left stick, touch the arena to aim and fire
• Keyboard and mouse or trackpad on Mac
• Three difficulties, from relaxed to ruthless
• Battle reports and personal bests after every round
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking

newReleases.name: Brain24: Math Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
Brain24: Math Puzzle — Challenge your brain with the classic 24 game! 

Combine four numbers using +, -, ×, ÷ to make 24. Train your logic, speed, and math skills with endless fun.

Features:
• Classic 24-point puzzle gameplay
• Multiple difficulty levels
• Brain24 Pro (One-time Purchase): Unlock unlimited hard puzzles, unlimited hints, and 100% ad-free forever

Download now and start your math brain training!

newReleases.name: Bolt Slapshot: Robot Hockey
newReleases.desc:
Lace up your steel skates and hit the ice! Bolt Slapshot is fast, friendly 3-on-3 robot arcade hockey for iPhone, iPad and Mac, and the hockey companion to Bolt Bowl.

Steer your robots across the ice, string passes together to supercharge the puck, and rattle the boards with glass-shattering body checks. It is easy to pick up in seconds and packed with real hockey action.

CHARGE THE PUCK & SCORE
• Pass to Power Up: Every completed pass charges the puck one level, up to level 3. Watch the puck glow brighter and fire faster, harder shots!
• Live Rebounds: A goalie save or a shot off the post drops the charge by one level. Losing the puck drains it completely.
• Bank Passes: Use the dotted aiming line to bounce clever passes off the boards.
• Shots, One-Timers & Fakes: Tap SHOOT for a quick wrist shot, or hold SHOOT to wind up a booming slapshot (just don't get hit while winding up!). Press SHOOT while a pass is coming your way for an instant one-timer.
• Smart Touch Controls: Skate with the left thumb stick and hit TURBO for a burst of speed that always stays in the same spot. Hold PASS and slide onto SHOOT to fake out the defense, or slide your thumb off any button to cancel.

CRUSHING DEFENSE
• Big Robot Hits: Press CHECK to knock rival robots flat on the ice and crack or shatter the arena glass.
• Active Sticks: Tap POKE to knock the puck loose and SWITCH to jump to the best defender.

32 ORIGINAL ROBOT TEAMS & FULL GAMES
• 32 Robot Squads: Pick from 32 original city robot

newReleases.name: DualShade Maze: Light & Shadow
newReleases.desc:
Step into the quiet, forgotten ruins of DualShade Maze—an atmospheric spatial logic puzzle where balance between light and shadow shapes every path.

Take control of two unique travelers bound to an ancient stone sanctuary: the steadfast Lantern Keeper wrapped in a teal cloak, and the nimble Coral Shadow companion. Together, they must navigate intricate stone corridors, activate interlocking pressure plates, reposition resonant stone blocks, and illuminate pathways to restore the heart of the ruins.

KEY GAMEPLAY FEATURES

- DUAL-CHARACTER MECHANICS
Switch attention between the Keeper and the Shadow companion. Every stone floor and gate responds differently to each traveler, requiring forward thinking and precise spatial choreography.

- SIX HAND-PAINTED RUIN CHAPTERS
Journey through 72 thoughtfully crafted chambers across six distinct aesthetic chapters: First Light, Light & Shade Gallery, Stone Courtyard, Resonance Hall, Exchange Tower, and The Return.

- ELEGANT SPATIAL PUZZLE DESIGN
Experience intuitive step-by-step logic challenges. Push engraved stone cubes along carved tracks, activate synchronized dual-pressure plates, step through phase corridors, and find the shortest path to each chamber's exit.

- IN-GAME MAZE BUILDER & LEVEL SHARING
Design your own intricate maze levels using the intuitive grid editor. Paint floor tiles, place moveable crates, set gate triggers, verify solvability with the built-in solver, and export your creations via standard level files to sha

newReleases.name: TD Farm: Phòng thủ nông trại
newReleases.desc:
Lũ sâu, quạ, nhím và cả vua chuột chũi đang kéo tới phá ruộng nhà bạn! TD Farm là game thủ thành nông trại: xây trụ, gộp trụ, trồng cây và giữ nông trại qua 40 wave quái.

XÂY TRỤ NGẪU NHIÊN, GỘP LÊN BẬC CAO
• Bấm nút búa, chọn ô đất trống và xây trụ: mỗi lần xây ra một trụ ngẫu nhiên.
• Gộp 2 trụ giống nhau, cùng cấp để ra trụ bậc cao hơn: Cơ bản → Nâng cao → Chuyên gia → Huyền thoại → Thần tướng.
• 35 trụ nông trại đáng yêu: gà con, ngỗng, bò tót, bù nhìn, cối xay gió, rồng ớt, phượng hoàng lúa, thần mưa…

4 HỆ KHẮC NHAU
• Lửa, Nước, Mộc, Đất: Nước khắc Lửa, Lửa khắc Mộc, Mộc khắc Đất, Đất khắc Nước.
• Mỗi wave quái thuộc một hệ, xem trước để xếp trụ đúng hệ, đánh mạnh gấp rưỡi.
• Nâng sát thương từng hệ ở nhà kho.

TRỒNG CÂY, KIẾM GỖ, BÁN NÔNG SẢN
• Trồng cà rốt, bí ngô, nho để thu nông sản mỗi wave.
• Giá nông sản đổi theo wave: giữ lại và bán lúc giá cao.
• Thả boss phụ ở nhà kho để kiếm thêm gỗ.

40 WAVE, 4 TRẬN BOSS
• Wave 10, 20, 30, 40 là round boss. Mỗi 5 wave có sự kiện chọn phần thưởng: tăng sát thương, tăng giá nông sản hoặc nhận trụ miễn phí.
• Vật phẩm huyền thoại gắn cho trụ Thần tướng: hoá băng, chí mạng, lông phượng hoàng…
• Nhiệm vụ thưởng gỗ, Vườn trụ và Sổ tay quái để sưu tầm.

CHƠI DỄ TRÊN ĐIỆN THOẠI
• Chạm trụ để gộp hay bán, giữ nút để xem thông tin.
• Chơi ngay bằng tài khoản Khách, hoặc đăng nhập Google / Apple để giữ tiến độ khi đổi máy.
• Kéo để dời bản đồ, chụm 2 ngón để phóng to.

Miễn phí. Bạn có thể xoá tài khoản bất cứ lúc nào ngay trong game.

newReleases.name: BeeBall: Spelling Hoops
newReleases.desc:
See the picture. Spell the word. Sink the shot.

BeeBall turns every letter into a shot. A picture pops up, its letters scatter across the court, and you shoot them into the hoops in the right order before the clock runs out. Miss a letter and the defenders will happily remind you.

Pick your game: 60, 90 or 120 seconds, from Rookie four-letter warm-ups to Career mode, which climbs as you play. Choose word packs from animals to world landmarks. Stuck? Grab a hint or skip and keep your streak alive.

Earn XP, chase medals, and unlock new balls, nets and courts in your Locker. Every word comes with a real picture, and scores stay on your device.

Short rounds, big swishes, and a very determined bee. Lace up. The words are waiting.

newReleases.name: AR对决
newReleases.desc:
AR对决 把真实空间变成靶场与战场。

举起手机，房间、走廊、办公室都能直接开打。单人模式随时进，整面靶墙在你面前展开，转身、抬头、压枪，打多久都行；双人模式两台设备连同一个 Wi-Fi，一台创建对局、一台加入，实景同场对决，谁的血条先空谁输。

· 不依赖环境光线与平面扫描，室内外都能玩

newReleases.name: Bean Tower
newReleases.desc:
The harvest has turned. Knives, forks and spoons are marching back up the road to the granary, and somebody has to hold the gate.

Stand your beans in the stone beds beside the road and let them do the rest. Every piece of cutlery that reaches the gate costs you a store; when the stores run out, the run is over.

MERGE THEM
Drag one planted bean onto another of the same kind and the two become one — brighter, stronger, and standing in a single bed instead of two. Four forms in all. It costs nothing but the second bean, and the bed you free is worth as much as the strength you gain.

FIVE DEFENDERS
• Viper, steady and reaching further than he should.
• Astra, who never fires a shot and slows everything near her to a crawl.
• Karmakaze, who does not walk to the trouble — she is simply somewhere else.
• The Favourite, quick and light, and worth double on anything she finishes.
• DuskX, who picks up what got past you and carries it back up the road.
Each arrives when your beans reach what they are waiting for, and tells you what it does the first time you meet it.

TEN CAVES, THEN NO END
Ten hand-painted caves, each its own road, six waves apiece. Hold all six and the next one opens. Past the tenth is the endless road, which does not end — it only keeps count.

PICK WHO HOLDS THE GATE
The Queen in her horned bone mask, or the King in his capped bandana. They hold the gate the same; the light they throw across the cave does not.

newReleases.name: Nard: Long Backgammon
newReleases.desc:
Everyone said iPhone Duo opens like a backgammon case. So we made it one.

Closed, the outer display shows the lid of a wooden nard case. Open your iPhone Duo and the board is waiting inside, with the board's brass hinges sitting right on the fold of the screen.

LONG NARDY, THE REAL RULES
• No hitting: land on empty points or your own
• One checker off the head per turn, two on a first roll of 6-6, 4-4 or 3-3
• No six-point blocks unless an opposing checker is already past them
• Bear off first to win; before your opponent bears off a single checker, it's a mars, a double win

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Against the computer
• Two players on one phone: lay the open iPhone Duo flat between you
• Tap or drag to move, undo within your turn
• Plays at any angle, flat or half-open like a book

MADE FOR THE FOLD
• Walnut, ivory and brass, drawn for both displays
• Made for iPhone Duo, and plays on every iPhone

One price. No ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no account. Plays offline.

newReleases.name: Penalty Kings: Football Duel
newReleases.desc:
Step up to the spot. Penalty Kings is a fast football duel: take five penalties, then go in goal and try to stop five more. Level after five? Sudden death.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Swipe from the ball to shoot: aim the corner, set the power, curve your swipe to bend it
• Then you are the keeper: read the shooter and swipe to dive left, right, high or low
• Go too early and the shooter sees you. Wait too long and the ball is in the net
• Real ball physics: curl, dip, posts, crossbar and a net that ripples

RANKED SEASONS
• Duel recorded rival sets and climb from Bronze to Legend
• Six-week seasons with badges and rewards for your best tier
• Your first loss each day costs no rank points
• Daily challenge, login rewards and free reward chests with the odds always shown

YOUR STYLE
• Balls, ball trails, kits, keeper gloves and goal celebrations
• Realistic players, day, sunset and night stadiums, slow-motion goal replays
• Cosmetics never change the result of a duel

FREE TO PLAY
Penalty Kings Plus gives double coins, daily bonus coins, a rival scouting hint and the exclusive Aurora set. Monthly or yearly. Coin packs, a starter pack and the Night Gold set are direct purchases: you always see exactly what you get. No paid random boxes.

newReleases.name: Solitaire Glade
newReleases.desc:
Step into the peaceful world of Solitaire Glade, where classic card-matching gameplay meets exciting surprises! Clear the pyramid, uncover golden cards, and discover delightful rewards as you enjoy a relaxing yet engaging solitaire experience.

 How to Play

Clear the Pyramid
Remove all the cards from the game board to complete the level. Each move brings you closer to clearing the pyramid!

Match by Rank or Suit
Select a face-up card that matches the current card in either rank or suit. The selected card becomes the new connecting card, opening up new possibilities for your next move.

Draw from the Deck
When no suitable cards are available on the board, draw a new card from the deck to change the connecting card and continue your game.

Use Wild Cards  
Wild Cards can connect with any card, giving you another way to keep your game moving when you need it most.

 Exciting Rewards

Golden Cards with Mystery Rewards
Uncover special golden cards to discover delightful surprises along your journey.

Spin Wheel Bonus
Reveal a designated number of cards to unlock the spin wheel and enjoy an extra moment of excitement.

Scratch Card Rewards
Complete a level to unlock a scratch card and reveal a surprise reward.

 Relax, Match, and Discover

Whether you're a solitaire fan or simply looking for a relaxing card game, Solitaire Glade offers a refreshing way to enjoy every round. Plan your moves, uncover hidden cards, and discover surprises along the way.

newReleases.name: Kick Legends: Football Hero

It's the 89th minute and it's 1–1. You have the ball. Kick Legends lets you play only the moments that decide a match.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Draw a line from the ball to a teammate to pass. End it in front of a runner for a through ball
• From the wing, draw a cross into the box and head it home
• Swipe towards the goal to shoot. Curve your swipe to bend it around the keeper or over the wall
• Defenders close the passing lanes and intercept, keepers read your shot
• Every goal gets a slow-motion replay from behind the net

• Start at a village club and climb through City, National and Continental leagues to the Global Cup
• 60 matches with free kicks, penalties, one-twos, crosses and last-minute equalisers
• Earn up to three stars in every match: score, use few touches, finish in style
• Finish in the top 3 of the league table to move up

YOUR SQUAD AND STADIUM
• Collect and upgrade fictional player cards: bronze, silver, gold and legend
• Pick your starting XI in a 4-3-3. Better cards shoot and pass better
• Grow your ground from 500 seats to 70,000. A bigger crowd pays more coins every match
• A new moment of the day and login rewards keep every day fresh

FAIR AND CLEAR
Player packs are bought with coins and always show their odds before you buy (bronze 70%, silver 25%, gold 4.5%, legend 0.5%). A gold card or better is guaranteed within 10 packs. newReleases.name: Tasty Swoop: Sort Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
A little order. A lot of yum.

Turn a shelf full of mixed-up treats into satisfying matches. Move snacks into empty spaces, line up three of the same kind, and clear the shelf to reveal what is hiding behind it. Doughnuts, drinks, burgers and more are waiting for their perfect spot.

Story: Follow the shop map from vending stops to diners, coffee-and-cake shops and supermarkets. Unlock levels, tackle bigger boards and earn up to three stars for a quick finish. There is no countdown, so you can take your time.

Arcade: Start with 60 seconds and add 5 seconds for every matching triple. Keep clearing shelves, carry your remaining time into the next round and see how far you can go.

Time Challenge: Make as many matches as you can in three minutes. No time bonuses: just you, the shelves and the clock.

MADE FOR A SATISFYING LITTLE BREAK

- Drag a snack, or tap it and then tap an empty spot.
- Match the front row to uncover more treats behind it.
- Use Hint and Undo when you need a hand. Magnet is available in Story and Arcade.
- Enjoy colorful food, crunchy match sounds, gentle music and haptic feedback.
- Turn sound and haptics on or off in Settings.
- Play in English or Ukrainian.

OPEN IT. PLAY IT.

No account, sign-in or internet connection is needed to play. Your progress and settings are saved on your device.

One shelf. Three snacks. Your next little victory.

newReleases.name: Sand Gallery: Block Puzzle
newReleases.desc:
Turn sand paintings into satisfying puzzles!

Every level is a picture made of thousands of colored sand grains. Drag blocks into the grid below — each block pulls sand of its own color from the bottom of the picture. Watch the sand tumble, slide and pour away. Clear the whole picture to win!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Real falling-sand physics — every grain moves
• 300 levels, from easy to brain-burning
• 25 famous masterpieces to clear, from the Mona Lisa to The Starry Night
• A new Daily Challenge every day
• Extreme Challenges: only 1%, 0.1% and 0.01% of random tries win
• Mystery blocks, rocks, frozen blocks and two-color blocks keep every level fresh
• Hints, Undo, Hammer and Magnet boosters when you get stuck
• 7 sand styles and 3 themes, including a cozy night theme
• No timer — play at your own pace
